statement: Help strength-training users plan and log gym workouts and obtain tracked progress, routines, and an optional Elite membership, reproduced offline: public discovery (exercises, routines, pricing), account access, the member dashboard (routine building, workout logging, progress, settings), and the Elite annual upgrade with a clone-local sandbox payment.
out_of_scope: individual blog posts (~900+; blog index only)
native mobile apps, watch app, and in-app purchases (App Store / Google Play surfaces)
real third-party services at runtime: Stripe, Google/Apple/Facebook identity providers, Strava (rendered per source UI; runtime behavior is clone-local)
publishing community posts/comments visible to third parties (create-post UI is in scope; clone-local posting against seeded data)
legacy /community deep pages beyond the landing page
Coach client-management product behavior (marketing page only)
